Class SDL_GPUVertexBufferDescription

java.lang.Object
org.lwjgl.system.Pointer.Default
org.lwjgl.system.Struct<SDL_GPUVertexBufferDescription>
org.lwjgl.sdl.SDL_GPUVertexBufferDescription
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, NativeResource, Pointer
public class SDL_GPUVertexBufferDescription extends Struct<SDL_GPUVertexBufferDescription> implements NativeResource
struct SDL_GPUVertexBufferDescription {
    Uint32 slot;
    Uint32 pitch;
    SDL_GPUVertexInputRate input_rate;
    Uint32 instance_step_rate;
}

  • Constructor Details

    • SDL_GPUVertexBufferDescription

      public SDL_GPUVertexBufferDescription(ByteBuffer container)
      Creates a SDL_GPUVertexBufferDescription instance at the current position of the specified ByteBuffer container. Changes to the buffer's content will be visible to the struct instance and vice versa.

      The created instance holds a strong reference to the container object.
